title: Figure 4: Distribution of Object Sightings by Evaluation for All Years and Each Year
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with bars for "All years" and each year 1947–1952, each divided into hatched segments for Astronomical, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other and Unknown. The y-axis is "Per Cent" (0–100), and the number of object sightings is printed above each bar (2199, 79, 143, 186, 169, 121, 1501). Dashed lines link category boundaries between bars. Caption: "FIGURE 4 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY EVALUATION FOR ALL YEARS AND EACH YEAR"; drawing A-7482.
